verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents a full REST API with official SDKs in five languages, API key management, an llms.txt endpoint, and specific reference endpoints (nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions, tax estimate), giving AI-native users a well-documented public API surface to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a directly reachable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found candidate paths 404) and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
